IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_BatteryFailed: Couldn't change the battery: the watch or battery isn't on you.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_NoBatteryToRemove: There's no battery in the watch.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_OneWatchOnly: You can only wear one map watch. Take the other one off first.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_TwoWorn: You're wearing two map watches. Only the one on your left wrist works; take the other one off.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ApiMissing: Map Watch is not active: the MiniMap mod is too old, so the minimap stays open. Please update the MiniMap mod.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Reason_Off: The server has disabled the minimap
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Reason_NoWatch: Wear a map watch to use the minimap
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Reason_NoBattery: The map watch has no battery
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Reason_Dead: The map watch battery is dead
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Status_NoBattery: No battery: insert one to restore it
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Status_Dead: Battery dead: insert a fresh battery to restore it
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Reason_FeatureOff: The server has disabled this feature
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Reason_NeedWatch: Wear a map watch to use this
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Reason_Need_mildet: The world map requires the Military Detector Module
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleFailed: Couldn't install or remove: the watch or module isn't on you.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_NeedScrewdriver: You need a screwdriver to install or remove modules.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_SlotFull: This slot already has a module. Remove it first to swap.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_SlotWrongClass: This slot can't take this type of module.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_UnlockFailed: Can't use the unlock card: this slot isn't opened with unlock cards, or the card isn't on you.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_AlreadyUnlocked: This slot is already open. The unlock card was not used.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_compass: When a target is off-screen, shows a direction arrow and the remaining distance at the edge of the minimap.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_ledger: Shows resource points like gun stores and pharmacies on the map, with a legend. Searching points by category doesn't need a module.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_gps: Road navigation, multi-stop trips, and one-click route home. Your own coordinates don't need a module.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_comm: Share targets with your faction and see teammates on the map.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_scan: Shows nearby vehicles and animals on the minimap and world map.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_detect: Marks nearby zombies on the minimap and shows zombie heat. How often it updates depends on the server's scan settings.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_mildete: Doubles the detection radius, and shows zombie positions and heat on the world map too.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_longcom: Faction sharing and teammate icons. Can replace the Comms Module.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_relay: Faction sharing and teammate icons. Can replace the Comms Module.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_eco: Halves the whole watch's power drain, doubling battery life.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_Core: The Relay Core and Power-Saver Core can only go here.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_Addon: This slot was added by another mod.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_Empty: Drag a module from your inventory here, press "Install Module", or right-click a module and choose "Install to Map Watch". Takes about 3 seconds and needs a screwdriver; moving cancels it and the module stays in your inventory.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_Card: This server opens slots with unlock cards. Use one %1 Unlock Card to open the %1 permanently. It's tied to your account, so it still counts when you wear a different map watch.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_CardOpened: Opened with an unlock card. It's tied to your account, so it still counts when you wear a different map watch.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_Paused: The %1 isn't open, so this module is disabled and uses no power. It's still on the watch; you can remove it and install it in another working slot.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_Dead: The battery is dead, so this module is paused.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_DrainHalf: None; halves the whole watch's drain
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_BusyInstall: Installing %1 into %2. Takes about 3 seconds; moving cancels it and the module stays in your inventory.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_BusyRemove: Removing %1 from %2. Takes about 3 seconds; moving cancels it and the module stays on the watch.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Drop_Full: The %1 already holds the %2. Remove it first to swap.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Drop_Class: The %1 is a %2-class module; the %3 only accepts %4 modules.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Foot_Charge: Battery %1%%, about %2 left (real time; about %3 on a full battery)
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Foot_ChargeUnderHo: Battery %1%%, under 1 hour left (real time; about %2 on a full battery)
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Foot_NoBattery: No battery: insert one to restore it.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Foot_Dead: No power: insert a battery to restore it.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Banner_NotWorn: This watch isn't being worn: modules only work while it's on your wrist.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Banner_NoBattery: No battery: the minimap shows "No Signal" and all modules are stopped. Insert a battery to restore it.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Banner_Dead: Battery dead: the minimap shows "No Signal" and all modules are stopped. Insert a battery to restore it.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_NoModuleToInstall: No modules in your inventory fit this slot
